systems.glicko2: Glicko-2, a tournament date as the rating period
systems.glicko1: Glicko-2's weekly pass with the volatility fixed at sigma0 (Glicko-1)
systems.glicko2m: Glicko-2 match by match: each round a rating period, drift by elapsed time
systems.glicko1m: the match-by-match pass with the volatility fixed (Glicko-1)
systems.trueskill: two-player TrueSkill, no draws, beta = 1, per-match drift tau, per-year drift gamma
systems.glicko_cs: correlated surface skills, Glicko's (Kalman) update match by match; RD0 and the weekly drift sigma as Glicko's; surfaces correlated rho (prior and drift); no blend
systems.trueskill_cs: correlated surface skills with TrueSkill's update; sigma0, gamma per year, rho
systems.ttt: TrueSkill Through Time, causal: weekly batches, one backward-forward EP sweep over the trailing window (weeks) after each week; TrueSkill round by round within the week

design.newcomer: mean 0 (1500 for Glicko), deviation RD0 / 173.7178 (Glicko) or sigma0 (TrueSkill)
design.surface: one rating per player and surface (hard, clay, grass, carpet), the same constants; means blended (1 - w) overall + w surface, the uncertainty on the variance scale
design.tuning: constants on the overall forecast's log loss, then w with the constants fixed (Stage 1's order)
design.widening: a best value on a grid edge (not a natural bound) adds one value past it, geometrically; up to 3 rounds

top10_rule: at least 30 rated matches before the player's last match of the last season
